name: chatgpt-clone
description: Builds the React app and starts the Express server that serves it.

scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm install --omit=dev --prefix backEnd
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix backEnd && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix backEnd && npm run format:check --prefix frontend
